name: Katherine S. Dunneback
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 9B

items.text: Katherine S. Dunneback is a speech-language pathologist and adjunct clinical professor at Saint Xavier University. She has worked in schools with many students from low-income families and is a former CPS parent. She opposes charter schools. She opposes any school consolidation. She supports expanding the Sustainable Community Schools program, which provides extra funding for services to the broader community. She has called for reducing large class sizes, less technology in classrooms, and expanding early childhood education. On funding, she does not support raising property taxes to the maximum. She wants the board to work with other elected officials to fund schools through other tax policies. She supports a graduated state income tax.
